name: grill-me-2
title_zh: 每个决策分支都追问到共识的拷问陪练
tagline_zh: 方案越说越含糊？它专挑你没想透的分支往死里问，直到你亲口说出每个选择的代价和前提，才放你过关。
tagline_en: Vague plan? It hammers every branch you skipped until you state costs & assumptions out loud. No pass without.
desc_en: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".
why_zh: 不是泛泛提意见，而是沿决策树逐支深挖，逼你补全每个分叉的推理，直到双方对同一张图景点头。
why_en: Not generic feedback—it walks the decision tree branch by branch, forcing you to complete each fork's logic until you both see.
limit_zh: 只适用于方案或设计推演，不接代码调试、不接情感倾诉；它只问不答，不提供建议，你得自己扛住追问并给出答案。
limit_en: For plans/designs only—no code debugging, no venting. It asks but never suggests; you must supply every answer under pressure.
title_en: Grill every decision branch until consensus
